correctness.rationale: A 3-by-m Boolean one-letter bimodal frame maps surjectively by the 3-bit word of each column to a support quotient H_S, preserving and reflecting both row and column successor sets; hence every valuation is represented by one of 255 nonempty supports S subset {0,1}^3, with 3072 pointed states. Finite depth signature tau_(d+1)=(tau_d,sets of horizontal and vertical tau_d successor types) is exactly modal depth equivalence by characteristic-formula induction. I independently constructed and refined all 3072 states in a separate program: depth 3 counts by support-cap 1..8 are [4,28,88,136,140,140,140,140], depth 4 [4,28,88,146,164,164,164,164], and depth 5 identical. This fixed point proves no further depth distinctions. Every type admits finite-depth characteristic formula, so exactly 2^N_m formula-equivalence classes; strict depth3/4 and cap4/5 counts prove sharpness.
